title: The BBC Story: 1920s
lineage: BBC history dates 2LO daily broadcasts to 14 November 1922 and 10 shilling licence introduction to 1 November; it says half the fee went to the BBC and gives 2.25 million licences in 1926. Institutional retrospective, not an audit.
